# Level-1 fixed vectors, IPv6 -> IPv4 (plan §3 WU1, §11). Read by
# tests/diff_engine.rs. One vector per line; `#` starts a comment.
#
# hex <name> <input frame> <expected output frame>
#   Core only, against an independent from-scratch reference with full
#   (not incremental) checksums, built like the WU0 spike's expected_v4().
#   The expected IPv4 Identification is 0; for DF = 0 outputs the test
#   substitutes the candidate's ID and recomputes the header checksum
#   (plan §2.4). Session (the spike's): 2001:db8::10 port 40000 ->
#   64:ff9b::203.0.113.5 port 53, pool 198.51.100.10 port 61000; ingress
#   MAC aa:aa:aa:aa:aa:aa; FIB smac 02:00:00:00:01:01, dmac
#   02:00:00:00:01:fe; ipv4_mtu 1500, copy_tos on.
#   spike_5b_payload is the spike's BPF_PROG_TEST_RUN output recorded in
#   plan §3 (6.1 and 6.8 kernels).
#
# case <name> key=value ...
#   Differential against the full plat-nat64 engine between the modelled
#   kernel hops (two-hop TTL model, plan §2.4): a session is created
#   through the reference first, then the described packet is sent.
#   Keys (defaults): prefix (64:ff9b:1::/96), payload (5, UDP payload
#   bytes), hop (64), tc (0), copy_tos (1), mtu4 (1500), mtu6 (1500),
#   lowest6 (1280), tun_mtu (1500), link_mtu (1500), csum (none |
#   in_ffff: input checksum field 0xFFFF | out_ffff: output checksum
#   computes to 0 and is sent as 0xFFFF), expect (redirect | a pass
#   reason). A pass also requires that the reference does not emit one
#   translated frame.
hex spike_5b_payload aaaaaaaaaaaabbbbbbbbbbbb86dd60000000000d114020010db80000000000000000000000100064ff9b0000000000000000cb0071059c400035000db5bd68656c6c6f 0200000001fe020000000101080045000021000000003e111689c633640acb007105ee480035000d674068656c6c6f
hex spike_1300b_df  
hex spike_3b_odd_length aaaaaaaaaaaabbbbbbbbbbbb86dd60000000000b110920010db80000000000000000000000100064ff9b0000000000000000cb0071059c400035000b3531616263 0200000001fe02000000010108004500001f0000000007114d8bc633640acb007105ee480035000be6b3616263
hex tc_copied_to_tos aaaaaaaaaaaabbbbbbbbbbbb86dd6b900000000d114020010db80000000000000000000000100064ff9b0000000000000000cb0071059c400035000db5bd68656c6c6f 0200000001fe020000000101080045b90021000000003e1115d0c633640acb007105ee480035000d674068656c6c6f
hex csum_input_ffff aaaaaaaaaaaabbbbbbbbbbbb86dd600000000010114020010db80000000000000000000000100064ff9b0000000000000000cb0071059c4000350010ffff656467652d69ff56 0200000001fe020000000101080045000024000000003e111686c633640acb007105ee4800350010b182656467652d69ff56
hex csum_output_ffff aaaaaaaaaaaabbbbbbbbbbbb86dd600000000010114020010db80000000000000000000000100064ff9b0000000000000000cb0071059c40003500104e7d656467652d6fb0d3 0200000001fe020000000101080045000024000000003e111686c633640acb007105ee4800350010ffff656467652d6fb0d3

# RFC 7915 §5.1 DF rule: IPv4 total 1259 and 1260 -> DF = 0 (ID from the
# counter), 1261 -> DF = 1 and ID 0.
case total_1259_df0 payload=1231 expect=redirect
case total_1260_df0 payload=1232 expect=redirect
case total_1261_df1 payload=1233 expect=redirect

# ipv4_mtu ± 1 with an IPv6 packet above 1280 (slow path: Packet Too Big).
case mtu4_minus_1 mtu4=1400 payload=1371 expect=redirect
case mtu4_exact mtu4=1400 payload=1372 expect=redirect
case mtu4_plus_1 mtu4=1400 payload=1373 expect=too_big
# ipv4_mtu ± 1 with an IPv6 packet of at most 1280 (slow path fragments).
case mtu4_small_exact mtu4=1000 payload=972 expect=redirect
case mtu4_small_plus_1 mtu4=1000 payload=973 expect=too_big

# TUN MTU ± 1: a 1501-byte IPv6 packet never reaches platd whole.
case tun_mtu_exact payload=1452 expect=redirect
case tun_mtu_plus_1 payload=1453 expect=too_big
# Egress link MTU below the packet: bpf_fib_lookup FRAG_NEEDED.
case link_mtu_plus_1 link_mtu=1400 payload=1373 expect=fib_frag_needed
case link_mtu_exact link_mtu=1400 payload=1372 expect=redirect

# Two-hop TTL model: output = input - 2; at most 2 is declined.
case hop_255 hop=255 expect=redirect
case hop_3 hop=3 expect=redirect
case hop_2 hop=2 expect=hop_limit
case hop_1 hop=1 expect=hop_limit
case hop_0 hop=0 expect=hop_limit

# Traffic class: copied with copy_tos, 0 without.
case tc_copied tc=185 expect=redirect
case tc_cleared tc=185 copy_tos=0 expect=redirect

# RFC 1624 / RFC 768 checksum edges.
case csum_input_ffff payload=8 csum=in_ffff expect=redirect
case csum_output_ffff payload=8 csum=out_ffff expect=redirect
case csum_output_ffff_odd payload=9 csum=out_ffff expect=redirect
case empty_payload payload=0 expect=redirect

# RFC 6052 §2.2 / §2.4 example prefixes /32 ... /96.
case rfc6052_32 prefix=2001:db8::/32 expect=redirect
case rfc6052_40 prefix=2001:db8:100::/40 expect=redirect
case rfc6052_48 prefix=2001:db8:122::/48 expect=redirect
case rfc6052_56 prefix=2001:db8:122:300::/56 expect=redirect
case rfc6052_64 prefix=2001:db8:122:344::/64 expect=redirect
case rfc6052_96 prefix=2001:db8:122:344::/96 expect=redirect
